text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm so lucky!! I have so many of the 
greatest rivals, and we got to run the 
greatest race together!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I lost today... I'm gonna run a 
race that tops today's! I'm gonna aim 
higher than ever, for sure!!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Infinitely! Again and again! Burn bright! 
BAMBOOOOO!! MEMORRRRYYY!!
